charge_port.notes: Estimated: CCS1 (J1772 native inlet) through the 2026 model year: press pages for this model line state CCS1 for 2024-2026 and NACS from 2027. Same port assumed for the Canadian car (Guide Auto 2024-09-18: Canadian owners need the GM adapter). Model year 2024.

supercharger_access.notes: US page: CCS1 cars use Superchargers with the GM-approved NACS adapter ($299) / optional adapter in GM's spec guide. Current state for model year 2024: adapter needed. Markets: CA/US.
